subject: Consumption harmonization & offset proposal for upcoming renewal
messages:
From: Maria Alvarez <maria@cargoflow.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.inference.com
Cc: contracts@cargoflow.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: Renewal discussion + consumption offsets

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We finished a usage retrospective for the past 12 months and wanted to start a conversation about renewal options. Key points from our side: we saw a ~40% spike in traffic over the last quarter but were well below our committed monthly baseline in Q2 due to a feature toggle rollout that slowed inference usage.

Before we lock a renewal, we need two things addressed:
- an approach that lets us bring our committed capacity up to meet the expected growth without doubling our unit cost, and
- a one-time offset/credit for the underused baseline from Q2 so we don’t get charged against last year’s unused commitment.

Attached is the usage_report_Q3_CargoFlow.xlsx with monthly token burn and the toggled deployment windows. We are leaning toward a 12–18 month renewal and are open to a stepped commit if there’s a predictable price hold on the unit rate.

Can your team suggest a concrete bridging offer? We’d like to present a simple proposal to our CFO next week.

Best,
Maria Alvarez
Director, Product
CargoFlow, Inc.
[Attachment: usage_report_Q3_CargoFlow.xlsx]
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@cargoflow.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:00:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + consumption offsets

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the report, that data is helpful. Quick thoughts:
- We can do a stepped commit with a unit price hold for 12 months if CargoFlow increases committed units by ~30% year-over-year;
- For Q2 underutilization we typically offer either: a one-time credit against the next invoice (pro-rated) OR convert unused commit into burst credits valid for 90 days.

Looping in Ben to draft a concrete offer and Marissa for renewals ops. Ben — can you sketch a numbers-first offer we can present to the CFO? Please include a short MA (mutual action) that covers a mid-contract true-up and an audit-log access clause for usage evidence.

Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

>

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Maria Alvarez <maria@cargoflow.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: RE: Renewal discussion + consumption offsets — proposed bridging offer

Irene / team / Maria —

Draft offer below (numbers illustrative; will formalize in the MA/SOW):

1) Term & Commit
- 12-month core renewal with option to extend to 18 months at same unit rate.
- CargoFlow increases committed GPU-hours/token-equivalent by 30% across the term (phased: +10% q1, +10% q2, +10% q3).

2) Unit price & price hold
- If commit is accepted, Redwood holds the current per-token unit price for 12 months from the effective date. Prices for burst/overage follow standard Tiers.

3) Q2 underutilization offset (one-time choice, pick one):
A) Credit path: pro-rated credit applied to first 3 invoices equal to 70% of unused baseline tokens from Q2; OR
B) Burst-conversion: convert unused baseline tokens into 90-day burst credits (non-transferable).

4) Signing incentive
- One quarter of additional committed capacity (equivalent to ~50k tokens) as a free burst pool in month 1 post-commit.

5) True-up & evidence
- Quarterly true-up with a 30-day notice window; CargoFlow gets read-only access to usage audit logs for any disputed period.

6) Next steps
- I’ll attach a draft MA and SOW with redlines for legal to review. If CargoFlow confirms the preferred offset option (Credit vs Burst) we’ll fast-track a join review with Legal and Finance.

Attachments: draft-MA-CargoFlow-v1.pdf, redline-SOW-CargoFlow.docx

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: draft-MA-CargoFlow-v1.pdf]
From: Maria Alvarez <maria@cargoflow.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: contracts@cargoflow.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 13:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + consumption offsets — proposed bridging offer

Thanks Ben — this is very helpful. A couple of clarifying items from the CFO and legal: 

- They prefer the Credit path (3-invoice pro-rated credit) but ask that the credit be explicitly allowed to offset any early invoices (not just the first three) if our ramp accelerates earlier.
- We need the price hold to extend to overage tiers for any committed-burst conversions (to avoid surprise costs during fast scale).
- Legal wants a mid-term true-up that allows for a one-time mid-contract commit adjustment without penalty, as long as forecasted usage is validated by both parties.

Also, can you add language to the MA confirming the retention window for usage logs (we require 13 months of historical logs for auditing)?

If you can get an updated MA/SOW with the Credit-path clarified and the log retention language, we can aim to sign by 2026-10-29 pending legal review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Maria

Maria Alvarez
Director, Product
CargoFlow, Inc.
[Attachment: contracts-summary.pdf — referenced inline]
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@cargoflow.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + consumption offsets — next steps

Maria —

Great, thanks — we’ll proceed with the Credit path and bake in the flexibility you requested about applying credits earlier if you accelerate ramp. Action items:

1) Ben to update MA/SOW to reflect: Credit-path wording, explicit ability to apply credit to early invoices if ramp occurs, extension of price-hold to overage tiers for the first 90 days of ramp, and 13-month usage log retention clause.
2) Marissa to open a renewal record in HubSpot and add the documents and timelines. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/CF-54
3) Internal: Exec review scheduled 2026-10-27 10:00 PT (Irene, Ben, Finance), CargoFlow welcome to join if helpful.

Please confirm you’re good with the timeline (aiming to have a signed MA by 2026-10-29). If that works I’ll get the draft sent to contracts@cargoflow.com for redline.

Thanks again — looking forward to closing this smoothly.

Irene Choi
Head of Sales
Redwood Inference
